h1: Custom Hanes Golf Apparel for Teams & Events
metaTitle: Custom Hanes Golf Apparel | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Hanes golf shirts, hoodies & tees for your team or event. Perfect for tournaments, corporate outings & giveaways.
introHtml: Hanes golf apparel combines the trusted comfort of Hanes basics with the relaxed style needed for the course. From tagless tees that stay cool under a polo to full-zip hoodies for cooler mornings, these pieces take decoration beautifully — screen printing or embroidery holds up wash after wash. Perfect for company golf tournaments, charity scrambles, or employee outing gear that feels broken in from day one.
heroAltText: Custom Hanes golf t-shirts and hoodies screen printed with corporate logo for team uniforms and event giveaways.
